scope: Layoffs & Job Destruction Level-4 canonical factors

definitions.A_DIRECT_OBS: An official agency publishes the measurement directly.
definitions.B_CALC: A deterministic AUXSAYS calculation from accepted official observations.
definitions.C_EVENT_OR_STRUCTURAL: A legitimate factor represented through official events, structural tables, or another non-conventional series.
definitions.D_TAXONOMY_OR_SOURCE_PROBLEM: The concept is too broad, duplicative, misleading, or unsupported and must not be forced into production.

factors.rationale: BLS CES publishes the total-private average weekly hours observation directly.
The Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts publishes business bankruptcy filing counts directly in Table F-2.
BLS BED publishes jobs lost at contracting establishments directly; Census BDS provides a separately governed annual counterpart.
Census BDS publishes firm-death counts directly.
BLS BED and Census BDS publish gross job-loss/job-destruction measurements directly with separately governed cadence and adjustment semantics.
BLS JOLTS publishes the hires rate directly.
DOL ETA publishes national initial unemployment-insurance claims directly.
BLS JOLTS publishes the job openings rate directly.
BLS JOLTS publishes both the layoffs-and-discharges level and rate directly.
BLS CPS publishes the permanent-job-losers estimate directly.
BLS CES publishes temporary help services employment directly.
BLS CPS publishes the job-losers-on-temporary-layoff estimate directly.
